checks.evidence: Action: Observe the moving overview, select each planet, seek 0/12/24/48 and 17/30/73/120, and compare readouts and rendered positions. Expected: One sun, exactly three distinct planets, circular fixed-phase 12/24/48-second orbits. Observed: One orange sun and small cyan Terra, medium orange Cinder and larger purple Azure render on three circular orbit paths. At time 0 their angles are 18/153/286 degrees; at 12 they are 18/333/16, at 24 18/153/106, and at 48 18/153/286. Moving positions, perspective and selected readouts agree with those periods and phases; repeated 17/30/73 positions remain stable across reload.

Action: Open fresh HTTP scenes and reload after persisting edited snapshots. Expected: Initialization at time 0, 1x, playing, no selection, overview, followed by motion. Observed: The immediate reload readout was 0.08 s, then 0.09 s, with 1x, Pause available, explicit No planet selected, disabled tracking and overview. Later snapshots show automatic movement. Stored edited time/speed/selection did not replace defaults; ordinary loading elapsed time is not treated as a reset defect.

Action: Pause moving playback, seek, wait 3.2 seconds at a restored 17.25-second state, use selection/camera, and resume. Expected: Frozen time and positions, usable camera/selection and continuous resume. Observed: Paused live-state readings were exactly equal across the wait and rendered planetary centers stayed fixed. Camera orbit/zoom and all three planet selections worked while paused. Resume from 30 at 2x continued smoothly; 30.42 to 36.85 over 3.206 seconds showed no reset or jump.

Action: Use 0.25x, 2x and 4x both paused and playing, change speed during playback, then measure sole visible review-scene intervals. Expected: No seek on speed change, stable paused positions and relative periods, and speed-scaled time after resume. Observed: Each paused sample stayed at 17.00 s before/after speed changes. At 0.25x time advanced 17.11 to 17.91 over 3.205 real seconds; at 2x 17.54 to 23.94 over 3.202; at 4x 17.98 to 30.78 over 3.203. All fit preregistered tolerance. State/readout and rendered positions continued from current time rather than resetting; fixed 12/24/48 period relationships remained unchanged.

Action: Seek 0, 30, 120, 17 and 73 using the slider; revisit 17/73/30 after speed, playback and selection edits and after reload; restore imported fractional 17.25. Expected: Immediate paused updates and deterministic positions/angles. Observed: All seeks paused. At 30 angles were 198/243/151 degrees, at 17 168/48/53.5, at 73 48/168/113.5; all three values repeated after reload. Action: Seek 119, choose 4x, resume, wait 3.2 seconds plus a further observation, then seek 17 and resume. Expected: Stop at 120 without wrap/overshoot and allow earlier playback. Lit spheres and front/back overlap visibly change, not merely labels or a flat drawing. Bundled fresh browser endpoint checks matched both loaded files.

Action: Run fresh bundled overview probes at mobile 5.2 paused, desktop 73 and 120 paused, and mobile 17 playing; inspect each actual screenshot after returning from Cinder tracking. Observed: State preservation passed all four probes, but Azure is cut off at the right canvas edge at mobile 5.2 and the left edge at desktop 73 and 120; portions of outer orbit paths are also clipped. Thus the overview is not full-system framing. Mobile 17 playing showed all planet bodies but did not cure the other observed states.
